units: <cite ref="Shabbat 129b:12">Sabb. 129ᵇ</cite> <he>יומא דמְפַגְּרֵי ביה רבנן</he> a day on which the teachers took a hotiday.

<cite ref="Ketubot 103b:17">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>ור׳ סבר לא אֲפַגְּרֵיה</he> and Rabbi thought, I will not cause him to relax (in his charitable work, by appointing him a member of the college; or ‘I will not wear him out’, overburden him).

senses.gloss: to take vacation, absent one’s self. Ib. 111ᵇ אי׳ … ולא אתא he (the teacher) took a three days’ vacation and did not come (to school). Ib. אמאי אִיפַּגְּרַת why did you absent yourself?

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> <he>מאי טעמא א׳ מר</he> why have you become indifferent (towards me)?
